profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name, formats and sign-in sessions.
profile.displayDescription: How dates, times, numbers and amounts are written for you everywhere in the app.
profile.sessionsDescription: Where you are currently signed in.
profile.signedOutOthers: You have been signed out of your other sessions.
profile.sessionsNotFresh: For your security, you can only see and manage your sessions within a day of signing in. Sign in again to continue.
profile.notificationsDescription: Choose what you want to be told about. Notifications show under the bell in the top bar.
profile.signOutOthersDescription: {count, plural, one {# other session is} other {# other sessions are}} signed out right away. This one stays signed in.

userSettings.saved: Your display formats have been saved.

member.listDescription: Staff in the organization and their access role.
member.detailDescription: Contact details and access for this member.
member.inviteDescription: We email a link. The person becomes a member with the chosen role when they accept.
member.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation to {email}? The link in the email stops working.
member.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the organization? They lose access immediately.
member.lowerRoleDescription: {name} loses what {from} can do and {role} can't, right away.

memberProfile.title: Work here
memberProfile.noStaffItems: There are no active staff items. Create an item of a type that is a person.
memberProfile.contactHint: How colleagues in this organization reach this person. Starts from their own profile.

descriptions.member: Sees everything except the audit log and the assistant's organization settings; changes nothing.
descriptions.manager: Also handles bookings and selling: orders, program, customers, quotes, payments and run sheets.
descriptions.admin: Everything in the organization: also setup, members, API keys, the payment account and permissions.

permissions.title: Permissions for {name}
permissions.memberDescription: What this member may see and do. The preset gives the starting point; switch single permissions on or off on top of it.
permissions.apiKeyDescription: What this API key may see and do. The preset gives the starting point; switch single permissions on or off on top of it.
permissions.presetSaved: The preset has been changed to {preset}.
permissions.changePresetDescription: All permissions for {name} are replaced by what {preset} grants. Permissions switched on or off on this page are removed.
permissions.lockedHint: Set by the preset. Only Administrator can manage members, API keys and the payment account.
permissions.alwaysVisible: Everyone can see this, since its names and labels appear across the app.

featureDescriptions.billing: Bibi's own subscription: the plan, payment details and seats.
featureDescriptions.order: Bookings with their lines (rooms, food, activities), statuses and holds.
featureDescriptions.inbox: Requests that came in by email, form or API before there is an order.
featureDescriptions.program: The schedule of a booking: what happens when, and where.
featureDescriptions.customer: Companies and people who book, with their contact persons.
featureDescriptions.quote: Offers with prices that are sent to customers.
featureDescriptions.payment: Payment links and payments for bookings.
featureDescriptions.runSheet: Versioned run sheets, such as a kitchen order, sent to a responsibility.
featureDescriptions.finance: Revenue, outstanding money and the SIE export to the accounting system.
featureDescriptions.item: What you sell: rooms, food, drinks, activities and bundles.
featureDescriptions.venue: Your venues and the spaces in them that can be booked.
featureDescriptions.priceList: Price lists with the prices of your items.
featureDescriptions.configuration: Your own types, fields and lists, such as allergens.
featureDescriptions.pipeline: The statuses a booking moves through and the states of its lines.
featureDescriptions.board: Which statuses each board shows, how they are grouped into columns and the board filter.
featureDescriptions.template: Ready-made bookings to start new ones from.
featureDescriptions.responsibility: Who is responsible for which items, such as the head of kitchen.
featureDescriptions.member: Staff in the organization, their presets and permissions.
featureDescriptions.apiKey: Keys that let other systems use Bibi's API.
featureDescriptions.paymentAccount: The organization's account for receiving payments.
featureDescriptions.integration: Connections to outside systems such as Fortnox.
featureDescriptions.audit: The log of who changed what, and when.
featureDescriptions.assistant: Everyone's assistant conversations and the organization's shared skills.

card.allowed: Allowed on top of the preset

permissions.explanation: Each feature has three actions: Read, Write (create, change, send, export, move status) and Delete. Write and Delete also need Read, so turning Read off hides the whole feature. Greyed-out cells come from the preset and cannot be changed here.

responsibility.listDescription: What someone answers for, e.g. Head of kitchen or Head of exhibits: the item types each covers and who it defaults to.
responsibility.createDescription: Name the responsibility, choose the item types it covers and who answers for it by default.
responsibility.editDescription: Change the name, the item types it covers or the default people.
responsibility.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the responsibility {name}?
responsibility.emptyDescription: Create responsibilities such as Sales, Coordinator or Head of kitchen.

hints.entityTypeIds: An order with a line of these types gets this responsibility.
hints.defaultFollowerIds: Members who are kept informed by default.

none.entityTypeIds: There are no item types. Create them under Types.

descriptions.scope: Name the responsibility and pick the types it covers.
descriptions.people: Pick who it goes to by default and who follows.

assignment.title: Assignee and followers
assignment.assignDescription: Pick the member who answers for this. Followers stay informed.
assignment.required: In its current status this needs an assignee.

auditLog.approvedBy: Proposed by the assistant, approved by {name}

seatRequest.heading: Seat approval needed

seatRequest.bodyInvited: {who} invited {invitee} to {organization} on Bibi, but all seats are taken.
seatRequest.note: Approve it to add a seat (49 SEK a month), or decline the request.

reminder.subject: Your team is waiting to get back into Bibi
reminder.heading: Keep your team up and running

reminder.note: It only takes a minute to get everyone back up and running.
